evidence_test: cd referee && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_revert_drill.py'  # Selection.*, Commitment.*, Judge.*, Run.*, CommandLine.*. 29d:42 names group revert_drill (MF14) but no page gives its command, stdin, output fields or cases (29h-29j stop at MF13; 29c's harness.drill judge is the stage-2 lesson drill and 29c:14-15 says MF14 does not use it). My choices, each bound by a test, to be replaced when the seed writes the interface (as seed-018 and seed-020 were): (a) commands: python -m harness.revert_drill commit|reveal stdin {drill_seed (lowercase hex), cycle_id, fixtures:[{id, cause, files?}]} -> {commitment_sha256} | {answer, commitment_sha256}; judge stdin {drill_seed, fixtures, commitment_sha256, answer, outcome:{reverted, cause}} -> {verdict: PASS|FAIL, reasons}; exit 0, 1 judge FAIL, 2 unusable. (b) selection = HMAC-SHA256(drill_seed, cycle_id as UTF-8), the fixture is fixtures sorted by id (code point)[int(selection,16) % n]; checked against RFC 4231 test case 6. (c) The seed's two phrases are read together: 29d 'taahhut HMAC(prova_tohumu, cycle_id)' is the selection, 29c 'sha256(canonical(anahtar))' the commitment; the answer {drill, cycle_id, fixture, cause, selection} carries the secret HMAC so the public commitment cannot be inverted by trying each fixture and cause (without it the commitment over a public fixture list hides nothing). (d) drill_seed at least 32 bytes (RFC 2104: a key shorter than the hash output is discouraged). (e) cycle_id is the committing cycle (asama-0/01 D8: the previous cycle's yaz commits), because the running cycle's Actions run id is not known a cycle earlier; the drill refuses a commitment from the running cycle. (f) Ledger rows: kind commit (payload without fixture or cause, outcome committed, verdict PENDING) and kind reveal (payload adds revealed_sha256, the answer itself, reasons; top-level cause when reverted). tohum/26's drill payload has no field for the revealed answer, no verdict for a row written before the run, and no kind values for part drill. (g) Judge reasons in order: commitment_mismatch (tampered_key), answer_not_from_seed, not_reverted, cause_mismatch; PASS when none. (h) Not in the seed's reach yet: the drill fixtures (seed/ is absent, seed-001) and the producer of the runs and facts at the planted head (seed-023, seed-029 (e), seed-030 (f)); run_drill takes observe(merge) -> (runs, facts).
